item.title: The Hosts
item.description:
Eric - Eric has been involved in a variety of different media before creating Tip Tap Tip. He was the co-editor of the popular Calgary-based magazine Squidmail with Joel Jackson during the 1990’s, and is also a co-host of The Salad Years. Twitter - @ericskilling Mastodon - ericskilling@mastodon.online

Rachelle - When she isn’t busting Eric’s balls on the show or encouraging him to don a leather daddy get-up, Rachelle is busy making art and taking care of raising their two young children. Rachelle’s art can be viewed on Instagram @artmom_artmom or her website rachelleskilling.com
